entries.title: Next.js RSC bundle safety, Tailwind v4 scanning, zero SSR crashes, and modal/overlay stability
changes: Preserved "use client" directives across dist/ ESM and CJS entrypoints by disabling Rollup post-bundling directive stripping in tsup
Added @source "./dist" to bigbullui.css so Tailwind CSS v4 automatically scans npm package utility classes without purging them
Removed invalid @ui/ and @components/ target prefixes in public/r/*.json so shadcn add places UI and block files directly into user alias directories
Fixed Popover and DropdownMenu trigger re-open race condition, Escape focus return, ARIA attributes, and ArrowDown/ArrowUp/Home/End keyboard navigation
Stabilized Dialog, Sheet, Drawer, and AlertDialog focus-trap effects via callback refs (preventing input focus loss on parent re-renders) and wired AlertDialogActionButton destructive styling

Rebuilt RichTextEditor DOM synchronization without duplicate text children or global selectionchange thrashing, and secured MarkdownPreview against javascript:/data: XSS links with semantic h1-h4 headings
Fixed 170 root component SSR crashes with safe prop defaults (reducing tests/ssr-baseline.json to 7 context-only subcomponents) and translated remaining Turkish strings
Added explicit type="button" across 117 UI components to prevent unintended form submissions, enforced by a new CI integrity test gate

Hardened CLI and MCP server: transitive BFS registryDependencies resolution, package-safe npx bigbullui add --all, in-memory MCP caching, /docs & /md lib route fallbacks, and behavioral component tests

entries.title: Working npm deep imports, installable hooks, hardened CLI
changes: Per-component npm imports now resolve (bigbullui/components/ui/<name> for all 659 installable entries)
hooks and focus-trap became real registry items: npx bigbullui add hooks and /r/hooks.json work
Blocks install cleanly through the shadcn CLI and npx bigbullui add <block>; ui imports are rewritten for the target layout
npx bigbullui mcp starts the MCP server; CLI gained component-name validation, 15s network timeouts and failure exit codes
bigbullicons: StampIcon name is a literal union of all 1099 icons and the package is safe in React Server Components
alert-dialog gained proper dialog semantics and focus trapping; coupon clipboard no longer crashes on insecure origins
